error.daemon_access_denied.message: 您的帳戶無權在此裝置上使用 NetBird 服務。請聯絡管理員以取得存取權限。
error.daemon_access_denied.description: Error: the NetBird background service refused this user account because an administrator restricted it to other users or groups.

error.settings_locked.message: 無法在此裝置上更改設定：管理員已鎖定相關設定。
error.settings_locked.description: Error: the local daemon was started with update-settings disabled, so it refuses configuration changes.

error.settings_managed_by_mdm.message: 此設定由你的機構管理，無法更改。
error.settings_managed_by_mdm.description: Error: the setting is enforced by an MDM policy. 'MDM' = mobile device management, the organization's device-management system.

error.unknown.description: Generic fallback error message used when no specific error applies.

error.elevation_unavailable.message: NetBird 無法向此系統要求所需的權限，請改為執行：
error.elevation_unavailable.description: Error: this computer has no way to prompt for elevated privileges. Followed by a copyable command that applies the setting from a terminal.

error.elevation_failed.message: 即使使用提升的權限亦無法套用此更改，請改為執行：
error.elevation_failed.description: Error: the authorization succeeded but applying the setting afterwards failed. Followed by a copyable command that applies the setting from a terminal.

settings.ssh.privilege.actorRoot.description: Fills {actor} in the settings.ssh.privilege.* messages on Linux, macOS and BSD, where the daemon requires the root account. 'root' is an account name and stays as it is; add the word for privileges or rights around it if the sentence needs one to read naturally.

settings.ssh.privilege.actorAdministrato.description: Fills {actor} in the settings.ssh.privilege.* messages on Windows, where the daemon requires an elevated administrator. The Windows term for the rights an account is asked to elevate to.

settings.ssh.privilege.hint.description: Help text under an SSH setting the user cannot change: it needs elevated privileges. {actor} is 'root' on Linux/macOS or 'administrator privileges' on Windows. Followed by a copyable command.

settings.ssh.privilege.oneWay.message: 你可以關閉此項，但重新開啟需要{actor}。
settings.ssh.privilege.oneWay.description: Help text under an SSH setting that is already on: an unprivileged user may switch it off freely, and switching it on again is what needs the privileges. No command follows, since the direction they can take is theirs to take. {actor} is 'root' on Linux/macOS or 'administrator privileges' on Windows.

settings.ssh.privilege.oneWayInverted.message: 你可以開啟此項，但再次關閉需要{actor}。
settings.ssh.privilege.oneWayInverted.description: Same as settings.ssh.privilege.oneWay, for the SSH authentication setting once it has been switched off: switching it off again is what needs the privileges.

settings.ssh.privilege.authorizePending.description: Replaces the help text under a guarded SSH setting while the authorization prompt is open, which can take a few seconds to appear. Keep the trailing ellipsis.

profile.ownedByAnother.name.description: Stands in for the active profile's name in the profile selector when that profile belongs to a different user account, whose name the daemon does not disclose. Keep it short: it sits in a narrow header button that truncates longer text.

profile.ownedByAnother.hint.message: 使用中的設定檔屬於其他使用者。只有其擁有者才能變更或中斷連線。
profile.ownedByAnother.hint.description: Sentence explaining why the active profile cannot be acted on: it belongs to a different user account. Shown as a tooltip on the profile selector and as a notice above the profile list.

error.privilege_required.message: 此操作需要較高的權限。
error.privilege_required.description: Short headline when the daemon refuses an action that needs elevated privileges. The daemon's own sentence, naming the action and what it needs, is shown as the detail.

error.session_held.message: 另一位使用者已在此電腦上連線。
error.session_held.description: Short headline when the daemon refuses an action because a different user account holds the active connection. The daemon's own sentence is shown as the detail.

error.not_profile_owner.message: 此設定檔屬於其他使用者。
error.not_profile_owner.description: Short headline when the daemon refuses an action because the profile it addresses is owned by a different user account.

error.profile_unowned.message: 此設定檔尚未設定擁有者。
error.profile_unowned.description: Short headline when the daemon refuses an action because the profile it addresses has no owner recorded yet. The daemon's own sentence is shown as the detail, followed by a copyable command that records an owner.
